# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Commands

- Run one test file: `Rscript -e 'devtools::test(filter = "trim")'` (matches `tests/testthat/test_trim.R`)
- Regenerate `man/`, `NAMESPACE` and `Collate`: `Rscript -e 'devtools::document()'`
- Lint a file: `Rscript -e 'lintr::lint("R/trim.R")'`. `.lintr` checks for likely bugs, not style. Existing code has known lints, so only fix those in code you are changing.

## Generated files

- `man/` and `NAMESPACE` are generated by roxygen2. Change the roxygen comments in `R/`, then run `document()`.
- `Collate` in `DESCRIPTION` is generated from `#' @include` tags. Load-order dependencies between files belong in `@include`, not in a hand-edited `Collate`.
- Never edit or rebuild `docs/`. It is stale and is not what gets published; the site is deployed to the `gh-pages` branch. To change documentation, edit roxygen comments, vignettes or `_pkgdown.yml`.
- `_pkgdown.yml` has an explicit reference index, so add new help topics to it.

## Code style

No formatter is configured, and `styler` defaults do not match this code. Do not reformat existing code.

- In `R/`, access S4 slots with `slot(x, "name")`, not `@`. `@` causes errors when running under OpenCPU in Docker (#295). Tests may use `@`.
- New user-facing messages use cli under the `verbose` flag, e.g. `if (verbose) cli_alert_info("...")`, not `message()`.
- New function definitions use `<-`, even though existing code mixes `=` and `<-`.
- S4 generics take `.Object` as their first argument.
- Declare imports per function with `#' @importFrom`.

## Tests and data

- Tests use the `GERMAPARLMINI` corpus (bundled in `inst/extdata/cwb`) and `REUTERS` (from RcppCWB, loaded with `use(pkg = "RcppCWB", corpus = "REUTERS")`).
- `GermaParl2` is optional: tests needing it use `skip_if_not(use("GermaParl2"))`.
- Expected values in tests are often hardcoded corpus counts. If one fails, find out why before changing the number.

## Versions and NEWS

- Bump the dev version and `Date` in `DESCRIPTION` once per logical change, not per commit, and add a `NEWS.md` bullet for user-visible changes. Do not change the version otherwise unless asked. `/finish-change` does this.
- `NEWS.md` entries are bullets, ending with the issue number if there is one (e.g. `#277`).

## Git

- Work and commit on the `claude` branch. The maintainer handles merging, so do not open PRs or merge.
- Commit messages are short lowercase phrases, with an issue number if there is one (e.g. `... #294`).
